topic: Unit 1: Fundamentals of Chemistry (Chemistry & Branches, History of Chemistry, Basic Definitions, Valencies & Chemical Formulae)
activities: Make concept map of branches of chemistry; draw and label structures of atoms, ions, molecules, compounds, and mixtures; group discussions on history of chemistry; worksheets on chemical names and formulas.
resources: Chemistry for Grade 9 NBF (Unit 1), Caravan Book House Chemistry 9, Chemistry Matters O Level (Marshall Cavendish).

topic: Unit 2: Stoichiometry (Avogadro's Number & Mole, Empirical & Molecular Formulae, Percentage Composition, Balancing Equations & Calculations)
activities: Construct flow chart for interconversion of moles, mass, and molecules; solve numericals on Avogadro's number; PhET simulation on balancing chemical equations; empirical and molecular formula calculations.
resources: Chemistry for Grade 9 NBF (Unit 2), PTBB Chemistry Class 9, Complete Chemistry (OUP), PhET Interactive Simulations.

topic: Unit 3: Atomic Structure (Features of an Atom, Isotopes & Uses, Rutherford & Bohr Models, Shells, Sub-shells & Electronic Configuration)
activities: Build an atom using PhET simulation; atomic structure worksheets; electronic configuration practice; video review on shells and sub-shells; draw Bohr diagrams for first 20 elements.
resources: Chemistry for Grade 9 NBF (Unit 3), Caravan Book House Unit 2, Chemistry Matters O Level, PhET Build-an-Atom.

topic: Unit 4: Periodic Table and Periodicity (Historical Evolution, Periods & Groups, Periodic Trends: Atomic Radius, Ionisation Energy, Electronegativity)
activities: Family characteristics color-coded index cards; element showcase mini-exhibit; family scavenger hunt; periodic trends worksheets; plotting atomic radius and ionisation energy vs atomic number.
resources: Chemistry for Grade 9 NBF (Unit 4), Caravan Book House Unit 3, Complete Chemistry OUP Unit 12, Science Notes periodic table resources.

topic: Unit 5: Structure of Molecules (Chemical Bonding: Ionic, Covalent, Coordinate Covalent, Metallic Bonding & Intermolecular Forces)
activities: Concept maps illustrating chemical bonds; molecular modelling kit representations; hands-on demonstration of ionic vs covalent conductivity using aluminium foil and salt solution; dot-and-cross structures.
resources: Chemistry for Grade 9 NBF (Unit 5), STBB Chemistry Class IX Unit 4, All About Chemistry O Level (Hodder), Chemistry Matters.

topic: Unit 6: States of Matter (Kinetic Molecular Theory, Gas Laws: Boyle's & Charles's, Liquid Properties: Vapour Pressure & Boiling Point, Solids: Crystalline & Amorphous)
activities: Venn diagrams comparing solids, liquids, and gases; phase change heating curves; PhET simulations for gas properties, diffusion, and states of matter; Boyle's and Charles's law numerical calculations.
resources: Chemistry for Grade 9 NBF (Unit 6), Caravan Book House Unit 5, Complete Chemistry OUP Unit 1, PhET States of Matter Basics.

topic: Unit 7: Solutions (Types of Solutions, Saturated & Unsaturated, Concentration Units: Molarity & % m/m, Solubility Curves, Separation Techniques)
activities: 'The Dissolving Race' rate of dissolution experiment; laboratory preparation of standard solutions of specified molarity; tissue paper chromatography; solubility curve graph interpretation.
resources: Chemistry for Grade 9 NBF (Unit 7), Caravan Book House Unit 6, Chemistry Matters Chapter 3, PhET Concentration and Molarity simulations.

topic: Unit 8: Electrochemistry (Redox Reactions, Oxidation States, Electrolytes, Galvanic & Electrolytic Cells, Industrial Electrolysis & Corrosion Prevention)
activities: Balance redox reactions by assigning oxidation states; compare galvanic and electrolytic cells with schematic diagrams; set up iron nail corrosion experiments under varied moisture/oxygen conditions; electroplating simulation.
resources: Chemistry for Grade 9 NBF (Unit 8), Caravan Book House Unit 7, Prescott O Level Chemistry, LabXchange electrochemistry modules.
